capabilities.name: Declarative skill workflow schema
capabilities.description: Defines bounded ordered workflow steps, explicit action types, tool adapter references, and per-step policy intent.
limitations: Schema validity does not authenticate a publisher, authorize an action, or execute a workflow.

capabilities.name: Local skill package validator
capabilities.description: Checks resource/workflow identity alignment, required metadata, bounded step structure, policy declarations, and JSON input safety.
limitations: Validator is local and dependency-free; it does not validate external JSON Schema references or enforce policy.

capabilities.name: Machine-discoverable skill package layout
capabilities.description: Separates Resource Manifest metadata from the versioned workflow document and includes a synthetic example.
limitations: No hosted catalog, search index, publisher directory, signature verification, or package distribution service.

explicit_non_capabilities: Publisher authentication, identity proof, signing, or reputation
Tool adapter loading, invocation, or sandboxing
Network access, secret management, or credential storage
